svg.title: Nengnanum Beauty — simplified collection storefront mockup
svg.desc: Editable luxury skincare storefront SVG with a midnight navy hero, ivory collection grid, restrained champagne gold accents, and editorial serif typography.
svg.text: A considered collection of rare botanical fragrances,
crafted in small seasonal batches at our atelier.
Discover your olfactory signature with a private consultation
and a considered selection of atelier creations.
Sourced with care, crafted with intention
Thoughtful details, made to be kept
Crafted in limited seasonal editions since 1988.
